title: Find the Second Largest Number
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the second largest distinct number. If it does not exist, return null.
think: What is the task asking? Return the second largest distinct value.
What is the key operation? Order the numbers and skip duplicates.
What wording signals stand out? Second largest, distinct.
What is the brute force idea? Track largest and second largest manually.
What is the better/clean approach here? Sort distinct numbers and pick the second from the end.
What are the edge cases? Duplicates, one distinct value only, negative numbers.
What is the complexity? O(n log n) time because of sorting.
How would I explain it in an interview? I take distinct values, sort them, and return the second last if it exists.
algorithm: Remove duplicates or take distinct values
If there are fewer than 2 distinct numbers -> return null
interview: A straightforward solution is to take distinct values, sort them, and return the second largest one if it exists.
ru: Здесь сортировка делает задачу очень прозрачной: убираем дубли, сортируем и берём предпоследний элемент.

nice: Do not mention O(n log n) due to sorting

gaps: Nice to have: discuss manual O(n) alternative
constraints: Assume array length may be small to medium.
whyThisPattern: Sorting is a clean fit because the task explicitly asks for an ordered rank (second largest distinct).
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not HashSet alone, because we still need ordering after distinct values are known.
Not Two Pointers, because this is not a positional scan problem.
